title: Liquid cooling doesn’t kill HVAC. It redesigns it.
excerpt: Direct-to-chip liquid cooling shifts data center heat rejection from air-side to water-side, redesigning facility and room-level mechanical systems, economics, and operations.

title: You can run but you can’t hide CO₂
excerpt: The EPA can repeal greenhouse gas rules for power plants—but satellite tracking, methane detection, and public health data mean emissions are harder to hide than ever.
